actions.uploadItemListNote: Download the list first (Download the layout). Each sheet is a category. Grey rows are already in the shop: their names and variants are locked, but the pale-yellow Selling price and Usual supplier can be changed. Write new items in the empty rows: Nepali name, English name, search group, variants, and price and supplier if you know them. Rule A: weights and counts of one thing are its variants. help.whatsappNumber: WhatsApp number (without country code). The website WhatsApp button uses this.
help.messengerPage: The Facebook page name or id. The website Messenger button uses this.
help.contactPerson: The name of the person to talk to at the supplier.
help.paymentTermsDays: In how many days after the bill the money is paid. 0 = pay as soon as the goods arrive, 30 = within a month.
help.buyerPan: The buyer's PAN number (if the bill needs it).
help.payeePan: The PAN number of the person being paid.
help.legalName: The legal name printed on the bill.
help.password: At least 12 characters; mix letters, numbers and symbols.
help.roles: Choose the role that says what this staff member may do.
help.branchIds: Which shops this staff member works in.
help.url: The full web address (starting with https://).
help.linkUrl: Where a click goes: a website path (/kits) or a full link.
help.href: Where a click on the menu goes: a website path (/kits) or a full link.
help.imageUrl: Choose or upload a photo. A clear, small photo (under 10 MB) is best.
help.images: The photos. The first photo is the main one.
help.coverImageUrl: The large photo at the top.
help.receiptUrl: A photo of the bill or receipt.
help.audioUrl: The link of the audio file (mp3). The website music button plays this.
help.youtubeId: The id at the end of the YouTube link (after v=).
help.tags: Words separated by commas. For staff searching and sorting.
help.traditions: The traditions this puja is done in, separated by commas.
help.popularSearches: Words shown when the search box is empty, separated by commas.
help.aliases: Other names of this samagri, separated by commas.
help.specification: The features and qualities of the samagri.
help.hsCode: The customs HS code (4-8 digits). Printed on the bill.
help.question: The question customers ask.
help.tooltipEn: A short description shown on hover in the menu (English).
help.tooltipNe: A short description shown on hover in the menu (Nepali).
help.label: The name of the pack. It is made from the options, but you can type your own.
help.billFooter: The text printed at the bottom of the bill.
help.qrLabel: The name of the QR (whose it is).
help.qrPayload: The text you get when reading the QR; paste it here.
help.payee: The name of the person being paid.
help.reference: The bank or eSewa reference or receipt number.
help.openingDay: The date the starting stock counts from.
help.dayFrom: Time of day: from what time.
help.dayTo: Time of day: until what time.
help.weekdays: On which days it runs. Empty means every day.
help.schedule: Always on, between two dates, or by day and time of the week.
help.aloneKind: How the price changes when the item is bought alone: % off, rupees off, or a new price directly. Leave empty for no change.
help.aloneValue: A number for that kind: 10 (%), 20 (rupees) or 75 (new price).
help.withKitKind: How the item price changes when a kit is also in the cart. Leave empty for no change.
help.kitTiers: One tier per line: "how many kits: how much off". For example 2: 10% = buy 2 kits and get 10% off each kit.
help.festivalId: If chosen, it applies only while this festival is on.
help.groupIds: Applies to all items and kits in the group. Make groups in Marketing → Item groups.
help.categoryIds: All items of the category and all its sub-categories.
help.variantIds: Choose only specific packs (for example black 120x129).
help.scopeIds: Choose which categories or items it applies to.
help.codes: Paste item codes from a sheet; separate with spaces, commas or new lines.
help.leaveOutProductIds: Choose items here that should not get the offer even if they are in the group or category.
help.leaveOutKitIds: Choose kits that should not get the offer.
help.leaveOutGroupIds: Choose groups that should not get the offer.
help.optionValueIds: The colour, size or weight of this pack: one value for each. If the label is empty it is made from these.
help.numberValue: Digits only (1.5 or 120). Choose the unit in the dropdown below; do not type the unit.
help.colorHex: The colour hex code (#rrggbb). White = #ffffff, black = #000000.
help.kind: Choose the kind. It cannot be changed later.
help.unitId: The unit of measure (g, kg, cm …).
help.packUnitId: The unit of measure of the pack.
help.defaultUnitId: The usual unit of measure for this samagri.
help.parentId: Which category this is a sub-category of. Empty means a top category.
help.materialId: Which samagri it is. It cannot be changed later.
help.taxClassId: Which VAT class. If empty, the usual class of the category or shop applies.
help.defaultTaxClassId: The usual VAT class for all samagri.
help.deliveryTaxClassId: The VAT class applied to the delivery fee.
help.mantraId: The mantra of this festival or puja.
help.ritualTypeId: The kind of puja (for example home puja).
help.tier: Basic, Standard or Premium: the three packages of one puja.
help.accountId: Which account it comes from or goes to.
help.fromAccountId: Which account the money comes from.
help.toAccountId: Which account the money goes to.
help.trigger: Applies automatically, or after a coupon code is entered.
help.scope: On the whole order, or on specific categories or items.
help.channels: Which ways of buying it applies to.
help.brand: Which brand or company makes it. You can filter by brand in Stock.
help.defaultSupplierId: The supplier this item is usually bought from. Useful for filtering when buying and in Stock.
help.barcode: The barcode printed on the packet. Scanning it at the counter opens this pack. Each pack has its own.
help.shelfLocation: Where this item is kept in the shop (rack or shelf). Makes it easy to find.
help.packed: On: the kit is packed ahead of time. Pressing "Pack kits" takes the items off the shelf once and the kit gets its own count. Even when an item runs out, a packed kit can still be sold. Off: the items are taken from the shelf when the kit is sold.

dataReset.removesHelp: Everything below is deleted in one go; you cannot delete just one part. It cannot be recovered afterwards.

groups.orders: Orders, bills and the movement of money
groups.searchIndex: Items and kits shown in search

groupNotes.catalogue: Category, samagri, item, pack, colour/size, photo, kit
groupNotes.orders: Orders, bills, payments, cash and bank transfers
groupNotes.activity: The log of what admins did
groupNotes.searchIndex: Search keeps pujas, festivals and articles

dataReset.alsoTitle: Also delete (tick what you want gone)
dataReset.alsoNote: What you leave unticked stays. If you tick it, it is deleted completely.

also.pujaGroups: Puja groups, ritual types and levels

keeps.settings: Shop settings: VAT, delivery, branches, bill details
keeps.website: Website menu, banners, articles, FAQs and site texts
keeps.pujas: Pujas, puja groups, units, mantras, festivals and puja articles (deleted only if you tick them above)

dataReset.confirmTitle: Sure you want to delete all the data?

help.details: The name, tax, tags, description and what shows on the website. After changing, press Save below. Photos and prices are not here: they have their own tabs.
help.packs: Enter the price of each pack here (for example White · 120 cm · Premium) and press Save below. To give all packs of one colour, size or quality the same price, use "Same price for" above. Stock is on the Stock screen.
help.options: If the item differs in colour, size or weight, tick it and press "Make packs": all combinations are made at once. Make the colour and size values in Colours and sizes.
help.photos: All photos of the item in one place. The first photo is the main one. If a photo is only for one colour or size, choose it in "Shown for": the customer sees that photo when they pick that colour.
help.offers: Tick which offers apply to this item. To make an offer, go to Marketing → Offers. Below, today's price for each pack is shown.
help.quality: The quality of the item (regular, special). A pack picks one. Leave it if you do not need it.
help.pairs: Other items that go with this item: shown on the product page and in the cart as "Buy this too".

itemWorkspace.morePacks: More: add one pack by hand, change SKU or pack size, switch a pack off or delete it

itemPhotos.note: Upload photos. The first photo is the main one (on the card and the page). If a photo is only for one colour or size, choose it in "Shown for".
itemPhotos.none: No photos yet. Add one so customers can see the item.
itemPhotos.altMissing: Alt text is empty. Describe what the photo shows (for example "Red cloth, 1.5 m"). If empty, the item name is used.

priceGrid.note: You can enter a different price for each pack: Price (what the customer pays) and MRP (the printed or old price). Cost and Margin come from the purchase bills; Margin = price (without VAT) minus cost. For example White 500, Black 450, Premium quality 500, Regular 400. For a bulk pack (for example a 25 kg sack) that is only for buying and repacking, untick "Sold to customers": it is not shown on the website or counter, but stays in stock.
priceGrid.forAll: Same price for all packs with
priceGrid.badPrice: Price must be an amount above zero, such as 500 or 450.50
priceGrid.badCompare: The old price must be more than the price

itemPage.notFound: This item could not be found.
itemPage.newNote: Enter the name, how it is sold, the first pack and its price. After saving, the item page opens, where you can add colours and sizes, photos and offers.

help.basics: The name, how it is sold (one by one, weight, length, size), tax, tags and description. After changing, press Save below.
help.packs: Tick the colours, sizes, lengths or weights the item comes in to make packs. The options that fit "How it is sold" show above.
help.prices: Enter the selling price and MRP (printed or old price) of each pack here. Cost and margin show by themselves: the cost comes from buying.
help.photos: All photos of the item in one place. The first is the main one. If a photo is only for one colour or size, choose it in "Shown for".
help.buying: Write here where you bought this item and at what cost. After "Save and add to stock", stock goes up and the cost is set automatically.
help.offers: Tick which offers apply to this item. New offers are made in Marketing → Offers.
help.more: Quality (regular, special) and other items that go with this item.

itemPage.stockNote: Check and correct the stock of each pack on the Stock screen. After buying goods, make a bill in Buying: stock and cost come from it. MRP is above in Prices and cost.
itemPage.qualityNote: The quality of the item (regular, special). A pack picks one. Leave it if you do not need it.
itemPage.goesWithNote: Other items that go with this item: shown on the product page and in the cart as "Buy this too".
itemPage.buyingNote: Write here after buying the item: which supplier, how many, at what cost. Stock and cost are set automatically. Later purchases can also be done here or by making a bill in Buying.
itemPage.makePacksFirst: First make the packs in Colours and sizes.
itemPage.morePacksNote: Many packs of one item: for example 1 kg at Rs 150 and 250 g at Rs 40. The first pack above is 1 kg; add 250 g here. Keep the unit the same.
itemPage.buyBigger: I buy it in a bigger pack (a bag, a roll)
itemPage.buyBiggerNote: For example buy a 25 kg sack and divide it into 1 kg and 250 g. This sack is not sold to customers; it stays in stock only for buying and repacking.
itemPage.bareNote: Only the name, how it is sold (one by one, weight, length) and the category. The pack, size, colour and rate are entered when you buy.
itemPage.bareNext: Now, after buying from the market, enter the pack, size, colour and rate on the Buy screen.
itemPage.sameName: This item has the same name as another item, but it is a separate item (tick only if the name is the same).
itemPage.similarNote: If an item with a similar name already exists, do not make a new one. One item is made once; only its stock goes up and down.
itemPage.similarSameWarn: This name already exists. If it is the item below, go to Buy and add stock.

repack.title: Open {name} into smaller packs
repack.note: Take some of a bulk pack off the shelf and add the smaller packs it makes. What the bulk pack cost is shared over the new packs by their size.
repack.opened: How many of the bulk pack are opened
repack.done: Done: the bulk pack is off the shelf and the smaller packs are in stock
repack.onHand: {count} of the bulk pack on hand
repack.balance: Opened {opened} {unit}, packs make {made} {unit}. Wastage {wasted} {unit} ({percent}%). Wastage is shared into the cost of the packs.
repack.tooMuch: The packs add up to {made} {unit}, more than the {opened} {unit} opened. Check the numbers.
repack.newAmount: How much in one new pack

kitPage.title: New puja kit
kitPage.note: The kit of one puja in one place: the name once, then each package (Basic, Standard, Premium) has its own items, photo and discount. Saving makes them all together.
kitPage.pujaHelp: Which puja this kit is for (for example Chhath). Basic, Standard and Premium are the packages of this puja.
kitPage.descriptionHelp: A short introduction: customers read it on the kit page.
kitPage.photosHelp: Photos shown on all packages. If a package needs its own photo, add it in that package below.
kitPage.packagesNote: Choose the packages and add their items. A package left unticked is not made.
kitPage.off: This package is not made. Tick it to add items.
kitPage.itemsNote: Choose the pack and how many. If "Optional" is ticked, it is not added to the kit price; it shows as an add-on.
kitPage.discountHelp: A discount on the total of the items: % (up to 50) or Rs. Kit price = total of items − discount.
kitPage.tierPhotosHelp: This package's own photos. If empty, the shared photos above are shown.
kitPage.summary: {count, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} will be made
kitPage.aliasesHelp: Other names: add one at a time with Enter or a comma. For example: chhath set, chhath samagri. The website search finds it by these names too.
kitPage.nameRomanizedHelp: How people type it in English letters: chhath kit. Helps search.

kitEdit.itemsNote: What the kit is made of: the pack and how many. Below you can compare the kit price with buying the items separately.
kitEdit.packedNote: {count} kits are packed. Pack kits takes the items off the shelf; Take apart puts them back.
kitEdit.notPacked: When this kit is sold, the items are taken from the shelf directly. To pack ahead of time, turn "Packed ahead of time" ON in Details.

flow.title: Bring something into the shop

hint.item: First enter only the name of the item. The pack, size, colour and rate are entered when you buy (step 2).
hint.buy: After buying from the market: from whom, what, how many and at what cost. The pack, size and colour are made here.
hint.prices: Enter the selling price of what you bought and put it "On sale". The buying rate shows here.
hint.work: Stock work: open a bulk pack into small packs (repack), damaged / expired / lost, count and correct, send to another branch.

flow.intro: Four steps: item name, buying, selling price, then stock work. One screen for each step.

buyPage.title: Buy: record what you brought
buyPage.note: Enter here after buying from the market: from whom, what, how many and at what cost. The selling price comes later (step 3).
buyPage.supplierHelp: Which supplier or shop you bought from. If it is new, first make it in Suppliers.
buyPage.billNoHelp: The number on the supplier's bill. If there is no bill, enter today's date (for example 2083-07-30).
buyPage.itemHelp: First make the item with its name in Step 1.
buyPage.packHelp: Choose a pack that already exists, or choose "A new pack" to make it here.
buyPage.amountHelp: How much is in one pack: 25000 (g) for a 25 kg sack, 100 for a 100 g packet.
buyPage.optionsHelp: Choose the colour, size or quality (optional). For example Black.
buyPage.quantityHelp: How many (or how many metres or kg) you bought.
buyPage.needPack: Choose the item and pack on every line.
buyPage.needNewPack: Enter the amount and unit (or colour / size) for the new pack.
buyPage.needRate: Enter how many and at what cost on every line.
buyPage.ready: Ready. After "Save and add to stock", the page to set the selling price opens.
buyPage.postedMsg: Added to stock. Now set the selling price.
buyPage.noPacksYet: This item has no pack yet. Make one by entering the amount and unit.
buyPage.packNameHelp: Leave empty: it is made from the amount and unit. Type a name if you want one, such as Sack or Box.
buyPage.mergeLine: {item}: a pack of this size already exists ({pack}); {qty} will be added to its stock.
buyPage.mergeNote: A new pack will not be made; stock is added to this pack. Is that right?

pricesPage.title: Selling price
pricesPage.note: Enter the selling price of what you bought here. Below, the buying rate (Cost) and margin are shown.
pricesPage.empty: There are no packs that need a price.
pricesPage.saved: {count, plural, one {# pack} other {# packs}} saved
pricesPage.save: Save {count, plural, one {# pack} other {# packs}}
pricesPage.badPrice: The price is in rupees and above 0 (for example 150 or 150.50).
pricesPage.hint: After you enter a price, the pack goes On sale by itself. Keep On sale only for packs customers should see and buy.

stockWork.title: Stock work
stockWork.note: Work on the goods on the shelf here. First choose the pack; your own branch must be chosen above (not Every branch).
stockWork.packHelp: Which pack of which item to work on.

taskNote.repack: Open a bulk pack (sack, box) into small packs. Wastage is shown.
taskNote.loss: Broken, expired, lost or spilled. It is taken off the shelf and goes to loss.
taskNote.count: If counting shows a difference, enter the real number.

stockWork.lossNote: How many are damaged, expired or lost, and why.
stockWork.countNote: The system has {count}. How many are there when you count?

expiry.title: Expiring soon
expiry.note: If 'Expires on' was entered when buying, it shows here. The older date is sold first. Write off goods past their date.
expiry.none: No goods have an expiry date.

itemGroups.title: Groups
itemGroups.note: If you put it in a group, it also gets offers, filters and the website "only this group" view. Remove a chip (×) to take it out of the group.

usage.blocked: This cannot be deleted: it is used in the places below.
usage.blockedHint: First remove it from those places (group, offer, kit…). Instead of deleting, Archive an item or kit, or switch a group off: the history and links stay as they were.

testMode.label: Working mode
testMode.help: Staging is for testing: anything can be deleted, even when it is used. Production works safely, as the real shop.
testMode.liveOnlyHelp: This is the real shop. Deleting is checked: something in use cannot be deleted.
testMode.banner: Staging mode (testing): you can delete items, bills and stock even when they are used. Switch to Production for real work.
testMode.bannerStaging: Staging server (testing): you can delete items, bills and stock even when they are used. Real work is done on the production site.

addItem.title: Add item
addItem.intro: Step 1 · Only the name of the item. The colour, size and how much was bought are entered when buying (Buy). The selling price comes later.
addItem.nameEnHint: Without colour or size: "Red cloth" is just "Cloth". Colour is chosen when you buy.
addItem.nameNeHint: Shown on the website and the bill, in Nepali: सुती कपडा, धूप, दियो.
addItem.sameNameOk: Another item already has this name, but this one is different: save it anyway.
addItem.howNote: How it is sold: one by one, by weight (kg), by length (metre), by litre, or by size.
addItem.categoryHint: Where it belongs in the shop and on the website.
addItem.nameRomanizedHint: How people type it in English letters: kapada, dhup, diyo. Helps search.
addItem.aliasesHint: Other words people search with (dhoop, agarbatti). Press Enter after each.
addItem.supplierHint: Picked first on the Buy page.
addItem.savedNext: Next: buy it, then set its quantity and price. The button below goes to the page for the quantity and price.
addItem.descriptionHint: A line or two on what it is and what it is used for. The website shows it as a tooltip beside the name, in kit lists too.
addItem.photosNote: The first photo is the main one. You can add or change photos later too.
addItem.groupsNote: Put the item in groups it belongs to (Tihar, Daily puja…). Optional.

buy.title: Buy
buy.intro: Step 2 · Goods bought from the market: which item, which colour or size, how many and at what cost. Saving adds them to stock.
buy.supplierHint: Not in the list? Add it on the Suppliers page first.
buy.billNoHint: The number printed on the bill the supplier gave you. Needed, so this purchase can be matched to their bill and returns can name it later.
buy.itemHint: Not in the list? Add it first on Add item.
buy.colourHint: Only if it has one: red, blue, L, XL. What is made from red cloth stays red.
buy.rateHint: What you paid for one, before VAT.
buy.sellPriceHint: Optional. Filled in, it goes on sale now.
buy.expiresHint: For food and ghee; leave empty otherwise.
buy.needSupplier: Choose who you bought from (top left). Not in the list? Press "New supplier".
buy.needQuantity: Line {n}: say how much, and the unit.
buy.needSellPrice: Line {n}: the selling price must be more than 0, or empty.
buy.ready: Ready. Saving puts it all into stock. VAT is added to the cost while the shop is not VAT registered.
buy.saved: Saved. It is in stock and on sale.
buy.savedNeedPrice: Saved and in stock. {n, plural, one {# line needs} other {# lines need}} a selling price.
buy.packetsNote: Buying ready-made packets (250 g, 1 kg bags) or opening a big bag into small ones?
buy.sheetNote: One line per item. If it has a colour or size, choose it (red cloth → red). The selling price can be added later if you leave it empty.
buy.newSupplierName: Supplier name, e.g. Asan Bazar Shop
buy.manyNote: Download the Buy sheet (Download the layout). One row = one thing bought: supplier, bill no., date, item, how much, unit, cost of 1 before VAT, VAT (13 or 0), expiry and selling price, as on this page. buy.itemSearch: Search by name, English name or code
buy.quantityDecimals: Line {n}: the amount can have at most 3 decimals.
buy.quantityTooBig: Line {n}: the amount is too large (most is 10,00,000).
buy.quantityWhole: Line {n}: this item is sold by the piece, so buy a whole number.

buy.rateTooBig: Line {n}: the rate is too large (most is 10,00,00,000).
buy.expiryBeforeBill: Line {n}: the expiry date is before the bill date.
buy.discountFormat: The discount is an amount such as 50 or 50.50.
buy.discountTooBig: The discount cannot be more than the bill ({total}).
buy.billTooBig: The bill is too large. Check the amounts.
buy.billDateFuture: The bill date cannot be in the future.

itemPage.notFound: This item was not found. It may have been deleted.
itemPage.stockNote: One line = one way the item is sold (for example 1 set, 50 g, 1 kg, 1.5 m). In stock: how many there are. Change the price and press Save.
itemPage.notBought: Not bought yet, so there is no stock. Buy it to add colours, sizes and stock.
itemPage.takeOffSale: Click to take it off sale
itemPage.priceSaved: Price saved. It is on sale.
itemPage.deleteNote: Production: an item already bought or sold cannot be deleted; you will be told where it is used.
itemPage.deleteNoteStaging: Staging: the item goes with its stock, bill lines and order lines.
itemPage.descriptionHint: A line or two the website shows under the name: what it is, what it is used for.
itemPage.showOnWebsite: Show this item on the website
itemPage.nextNote: If anything is left, do it from here. When all are green, the item is ready to sell.
itemPage.nextPrice: No selling price yet: the item cannot be sold.
itemPage.nextPriceDone: Has a selling price, so it can be sold.
itemPage.nextStock: Nothing in stock: buy it first.
itemPage.colCsHelp: How the customer buys it: one set, 50 g, 1 kg, 1.5 m…
itemPage.colCostHelp: What one cost when it was bought (from the bills).
itemPage.addSizeNote: If it is also sold in another size (for example 2 kg along with 1 kg): the amount, unit and price.
itemPage.photosNote: The first photo is the main one on the website.
itemPage.groupsNote: Tick the groups this item belongs to (Tihar, Daily puja…). Groups shown on the website become filters there.
itemPage.expert: Expert settings: tax, HS code, offers, quality, goes with… (rarely needed)

stockWipe.title: Delete all stock of {name}?
stockWipe.note: Staging only. The count goes to 0 and its history and batches are removed here, as if it was never bought. Bills stay; delete a bill to take it back instead.

catalogueSheet.hint: Many pujas, kits or groups at once?
catalogueSheet.title: Pujas, kits and groups with Excel
catalogueSheet.note: Download the layout: it has the pujas, kits and groups already saved (grey, locked) and empty rows below. Fill the sheets in order: Puja Groups (a parent group nests them as deep as you like: चाडपर्व → दशैं → नवरात्र), Pujas, Puja Samagri (a search group from the item list), Kits ("make from puja samagri: हो" fills it from items on sale; "होइन" takes the items on Kit Items), Kit Items, Item Groups (nested the same way; "show on website: हो" makes a filter) and Group Items. Check the file, then Import. Uploading the same file again adds only the new rows.

groupForm.categoryChecking: Checking how many items the category has…
groupForm.categoryAdds: Note: all items of this category (including sub-categories) go into the group, about {count}. To pick only some, use "Add items" below and leave this empty.

customerReturn.detailNote: The goods went back on the shelf or were written off as shown. The credit lowers what the order is owed; money paid back is in the order's payments.
customerReturn.note: A customer brought something back from an order: choose the order, what came back, why, whether it can be sold again, and whether the money goes back now.
customerReturn.orderHint: Search by order number, name or phone.
customerReturn.outcomeNote: Back on the shelf: it is counted in stock again and can be sold. Write off: it is a loss (broken, spoiled, used); stock does not go up.
customerReturn.needLines: Enter how many came back of at least one item.
customerReturn.fixLines: Fix the quantities marked in red.
customerReturn.noteHint: Optional: anything worth remembering (the box was crushed, wrong colour).
customerReturn.payLater: No money is paid now. The order will show a refund due, to pay from the order page.
customerReturn.amountHint: Up to {max}. Empty pays all of it.
customerReturn.needAmount: Enter the amount to pay back.
customerReturn.amountTooBig: At most {max} can be paid back on this order.
customerReturn.needReference: A reference (receipt or transaction number) is needed for this way of paying.
customerReturn.nothing: This order has nothing that can be returned.

quantityPrice.itemHint: Any item, of any category. Search by name or code.
quantityPrice.itemSearch: Search by name, English name or code
quantityPrice.helpLine: Press Save to keep your changes.
quantityPrice.removeNote: The removed quantities are deleted when you save. One that already has stock or bills cannot be deleted: untick On sale instead.
